summary: Frontend-only regression test for the new MethodologyCard component across all 4 assessment pages (/prep/readiness, /prep/communication, /neurodivergent, /safety-assessment). All acceptance criteria pass: card visible on load, correct chip/name/purpose/disclaimer, correct blue vs rust theme, toggle expand/collapse, 5 detail sections in specified order, sources rendered as bulleted list, and existing page content (video/questions/CTA/wizard) still present below the card.
critical_code_review_comments: MethodologyCard.jsx is clean and self-contained. Section icons use hardcoded purple color (#3D1A78) even inside the rust safety card — visually acceptable but not strictly themed. Minor cosmetic; no action required.
Disclaimer text is duplicated across every card via component (single source of truth) — good.
methodology.js is a plain data module; sources array length is 3-4 as spec. No secrets/URLs — safe.
test_credentials: Guest bootstrap via POST /api/auth/guest {name:'Test Reader'} — no explicit credentials needed
seed_data_creation: None. Only localStorage keys sac_legal_ack_v1 and sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1 were set to bypass legal/orientation gates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MethodologyCard shared component is stable at /app/frontend/src/components/MethodologyCard.jsx and consumes /app/frontend/src/lib/methodology.js. data-testids: methodology-card-<id>, methodology-category-<id>, methodology-name-<id>, methodology-purpose-<id>, methodology-toggle-<id>, methodology-details-<id> (only present when expanded), methodology-disclaimer-<id>. IDs used: readiness, comm_style, special_needs, safety. Blue name color is rgb(46,75,138) = #2E4B8A; rust is rgb(140,58,27) = #8C3A1B. Details container mounts on toggle click (React conditional render — not just hidden CSS).
